open_points.subject: create replay after an ordinary change to the created record
open_points.text: This holds while the record the first create made keeps its values
open_points.question: Does a correction or lifecycle change mean that the record no longer “keeps its values,” so repeating the original create is treated as a new create, or does replay recognition continue while the record still exists with its create request id?
options: A correction, restriction, relationship change or archive ends replay recognition and the repeated create is new
Replay recognition continues through ordinary changes and ends only when erasure, anonymisation or deletion removes its identifying facts
Only changes to facts originally supplied by the create end replay recognition; status-only changes do not
open_points.default_guess: Replay recognition continues through ordinary changes and ends only when destructive erasure, anonymisation or deletion removes the create request id.

witness.initial: Customer C exists from a successful record-customer request R, with its original name and phone.
events: The caller repeats request R after losing its original answer.
outcomes: Registry recognises R and returns the existing, corrected Customer C.
Because C no longer keeps all values supplied by R, Registry treats R as a new create and records a second Customer.
witness.observer: The owner, who sees one Customer or two in the customer list.

open_points.subject: project-create replay after whole-project deletion
open_points.text: Erasing a customer or anonymising a project removes everything that would tell a repeat ... a create repeated after that is a new create
open_points.question: Does deleting an archived project whole also make a repetition of its create request a new create, or is the new exception limited to the two named cases?
options: Whole-project deletion also forgets the create and a repeat creates a new project
Only customer erasure and project anonymisation have the stated replay consequence; the result after whole-project deletion remains unspecified or refused
open_points.default_guess: Whole-project deletion also forgets the create, so a repeat is handled as a new create.

witness.initial: Active project P was created by request R and later archived.
events: The owner confirms deletion of P whole.
outcomes: Registry treats R as a new create and mints a new project.
Registry does not apply the newly stated exception because it names anonymisation but not whole deletion, so the repeat is refused or otherwise not defined as a new create.
witness.observer: The owner, who either sees the newly created project or a refusal.

open_points.subject: room-create replay after its project is anonymised
open_points.text: anonymising a project removes everything that would tell a repeat ... a create repeated after that is a new create, and its answer shows the new record it made
open_points.question: When anonymisation has removed a room and its create request id, must a repeated add-room request create a new Room as this passage says, or must it be refused because the target project remains archived and anonymised?
options: The repeated request creates a new Room record despite the project being anonymised
The repeated request is refused because adding a room to an archived project is forbidden
The passage applies only to repeating the Project create, not to room creates removed by that anonymisation
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the room create because the project is archived; clarify that the new passage applies only to the anonymised Project's own create replay.

witness.initial: Active project P contains room X, created by request R.
events: The owner anonymises P, removing its rooms and their request ids.
The owner or an agent repeats room-create request R for P.
outcomes: The changed R0-36 requires a new Room and an answer showing it.
The add-room action and P's archived status require refusal; an anonymised project keeps no rooms.
witness.observer: The owner or agent receives either a new room or a refusal.

open_points.subject: project-create replay after anonymisation when its customer is no longer eligible
open_points.text: a create repeated after that is a new create, and its answer shows the new record it made
open_points.question: If the repeated project create still names a Customer that has since become erased, restricted or ended, does the new passage require creation, or do the current project-create eligibility checks refuse it?
options: The repeated create makes a new project despite the Customer's current state
It is treated as a fresh create and refused by the current Customer eligibility checks
The replay recreates the project without its former customer link
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as a fresh create subject to current eligibility checks, so refuse it; revise the unconditional claim that its answer shows a new record.

witness.initial: Project P was created by request R naming active Customer C.
events: The owner archives and anonymises P.
The owner erases C's contact data, restricts C, or ends C's relationship.
The caller repeats R with the original customer_ref.
outcomes: The changed R0-36 says the answer shows the new Project the repeated create made.
The create-project action refuses a customer reference that is erased, restricted or ended, so no Project is made.
witness.observer: The owner receives either a new project or a refusal.
